strings.UI_CHAIN_CAT_1: Sir Whiskers, the barkeep's cat, has run off again. He was last seen chasing fish by the docks. Lure him out with some fish.
strings.UI_CHAIN_CAT_2: He ate every sprat and ran into the woods. Follow the scratch marks on the trees.
strings.UI_CHAIN_CAT_3: Pinned to a stump: 'I have your cat. Answer my riddle: what has keys but opens no locks? 1) A piano 2) A jailer 3) A cat'
strings.UI_CHAIN_CAT_4: A gull drops a note: the cat was seen on a fishing boat bound for Kyo.
strings.UI_CHAIN_CAT_5: There he is on Kyo, asleep on a pile of fish bones, guarded by angry locals. Clear a way back.
strings.UI_CHAIN_CAT_END: Sir Whiskers is home. The barkeep is in tears. The cat ignores you completely.
strings.UI_CHAIN_FISH_1: Old Finn swears a giant fish keeps stealing his bait. Catch some fish to show him you know your way around a rod.
strings.UI_CHAIN_FISH_2: Finn needs fresh bait for the big one. Bring him shrimp.
strings.UI_CHAIN_FISH_3: The giant fish was spotted off Heim. Sail there and look for it.
strings.UI_CHAIN_FISH_4: It got away. Of course it did. Finn asks: when is the best time to catch a fish? 1) At dawn 2) At dusk 3) When it is not looking
strings.UI_CHAIN_FISH_5: Finn's new plan: a net. A big one. Bring hemp.
strings.UI_CHAIN_FISH_6: The net is ready. Now fish like you have never fished before.
strings.UI_CHAIN_FISH_END: You caught it! It is... a sprat. A very, very big sprat. Finn has it mounted for your village.
strings.UI_CHAIN_FISH_WRONG: Finn shakes his head. 'Fish do not care what time it is.'
strings.UI_CHAIN_FOUNDER_1: The town hall's oldest record says a hero founded this village, but nobody remembers who. The mayor wants a statue anyway. Mine good stone for it.
strings.UI_CHAIN_FOUNDER_2: The sculptor needs iron for the statue's frame.
strings.UI_CHAIN_FOUNDER_4: An old book says the founder once cleared a dungeon alone. The sculptor wants to know how that felt. Go and find out.
strings.UI_CHAIN_FOUNDER_5: The workshop is behind on its orders. Craft a few things for the sculptor.
strings.UI_CHAIN_FOUNDER_6: The sculptor asks: what should the founder hold? 1) A sword 2) A book 3) A sandwich
strings.UI_CHAIN_FOUNDER_7: The statue is nearly done. Cook for the unveiling feast.
strings.UI_CHAIN_FOUNDER_END: The statue is unveiled to cheers. Nobody agrees on what it is holding, but everyone agrees it looks heroic.
strings.UI_CHAIN_SHIPWRIGHT_1: A shipwright on Away says the ferries are old and tired, and she wants to build something new. Sail to Away to meet her.
strings.UI_CHAIN_SHIPWRIGHT_2: First, timber. Lots of it. Chop trees.
strings.UI_CHAIN_SHIPWRIGHT_3: Bring her logs for the hull.
strings.UI_CHAIN_SHIPWRIGHT_4: Bring her iron ore for nails and fittings.
strings.UI_CHAIN_SHIPWRIGHT_5: Bring her resin to seal the hull.
strings.UI_CHAIN_SHIPWRIGHT_6: Pirates have been eyeing the shipyard. Win a raid to scare them off.
strings.UI_CHAIN_SHIPWRIGHT_7: Bring her coal for the forge, for the last fittings.
strings.UI_CHAIN_SHIPWRIGHT_END: The keel is laid! The first piece of your own boat is ready, waiting for the day you sail it.
strings.UI_CHAIN_PUMPKIN_1: Something stirs in the pumpkin patch. Harvest it before it harvests you.
strings.UI_CHAIN_PUMPKIN_2: The pumpkins have faces now, and friends. Defeat the spirits that came with them.
strings.UI_CHAIN_PUMPKIN_3: A hollow voice from the patch: 'What room has no doors and no windows? 1) A mushroom 2) A tomb 3) A ballroom'
strings.UI_CHAIN_PUMPKIN_4: The Pumpkin King wants a gift: thirteen mushrooms, at midnight.
strings.UI_CHAIN_PUMPKIN_5: He says the old runestone in Ironhill glows tonight. Go there.
strings.UI_CHAIN_PUMPKIN_END: The Pumpkin King bows and gives your village a lantern that never goes out.
strings.UI_CHAIN_PUMPKIN_WRONG: The whole patch laughs at you.

strings.UI_STORY_RUNESTONE_HOOK: A runestone in the Ironhill cave hums faintly. Power is emerging... but nothing seems to happen.
strings.UI_STORY_RUNESTONE_1: You lay a hand on the stone. It is warm, and a voice whispers: 'Wake me.'
strings.UI_STORY_RUNESTONE_2: Shadows crawl out of the cave the moment it whispers. Clear them so the stone can breathe.
strings.UI_STORY_RUNESTONE_3: Its old iron bands have rusted away. Bring iron to bind it again.
strings.UI_STORY_RUNESTONE_4: Now fire to forge them. Bring coal.
strings.UI_STORY_RUNESTONE_5: Three rune fragments broke off long ago and lie somewhere in the mines. Whoever mines may find them.
strings.UI_STORY_RUNESTONE_6: The fragments fit, and something below stirs. Conquer two dungeons to calm the deep.
strings.UI_STORY_RUNESTONE_7: The runestone glows and asks what blessing your village wants: 1) Strength 2) Craft 3) Nature
strings.UI_STORY_RUNESTONE_8: It is ready. Speak the word and it will wake.
strings.UI_STORY_RUNESTONE_END: The runestone wakes with a roar of light. Its blessing settles over the village, and deep in the cave a path you have never seen opens...
strings.UI_STORY_BANANAS_HOOK: North east of the village lies a mangrove island. A sign floats over it: insufficient bananas.
strings.UI_STORY_BANANAS_1: A large monkey on the jetty points at the sign, then at you, then at the sign again.
strings.UI_STORY_BANANAS_2: Bananas do not grow on your islands... but gatherers keep finding wild ones. Find as many as the chief wants.
strings.UI_STORY_BANANAS_3: The chief wants to see how many friends you have. Fill the stream.
strings.UI_STORY_BANANAS_4: Monkeys like fish too, it turns out. Bring raw sprat.
strings.UI_STORY_BANANAS_5: Pirates keep stealing the monkeys' bananas. Win two raids to scare them off.
strings.UI_STORY_BANANAS_6: The chief wants a name. What will you call him? 1) Bonzo 2) Sir Bananas 3) Kevin
strings.UI_STORY_BANANAS_7: The chief looks at the pile of bananas and nods slowly.
strings.UI_STORY_BANANAS_END: SUFFICIENT BANANAS! The sign changes, the monkeys cheer, and the chief gives you his finest statue of himself.

strings.UI_TAVERN_GHOST_BARKEEP_LINES: Boo! I mean... what'll it be?|Our ale is to die for. Trust me.|Mind the pumpkins, they bite back.|I've been tending this bar for three hundred years. Tips welcome.
strings.UI_TAVERN_SHOPKEEPER_LINES: The shop opens for the festivals.|Festival wares only, I'm afraid.|Come back when the season turns.|Everything on these shelves is for display. For now.

strings.UI_SETTINGS_KEYS_FIXED: Esc always opens the menu and backs out of windows, and the free camera flies with WASD, Q and E.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_KEYS_HINT: Click a key to change it, then press the new one. Esc cancels, Backspace leaves it unbound. A key already in use swaps over.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LABELS_HINT: Text and json files your streaming software can show.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LABELS_JSON_HINT: The same values as json, for overlays that read data.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LABELS_TEXT_HINT: One plain text file per value, the easiest to add as a text source in OBS.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LANGUAGE_HINT: For the interface and the bot's messages in your chat. A few windows switch over when the game reloads.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LOCAL_BOT: Accept a bot on this computer
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LOCAL_BOT_HINT: For streamers who run RavenBot themselves.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LOCAL_PORT_HINT: The port a bot on this computer connects to.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LOOK_HINT: Turning speed while holding the right mouse button or Ctrl in the free camera.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LOOT_ORIGIN_HINT: !loot replies tell whether each item dropped in a raid or a dungeon.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_MASTER_HINT: All of the game's sound at once.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_MUSIC_HINT: The background music and the raid music.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_NAMES_HINT: The name tags above characters in the world.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_NO_DUNGEONS_HINT: No dungeons start at all, neither on their own nor by chat command.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_NO_EXP: Warn players who gain no exp
strings.UI_SETTINGS_NO_EXP_HINT: The bot points anyone training where they gain nothing to a better island.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_NO_EXP_TIME_HINT: Later warnings wait five times as long.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_NO_RAIDS_HINT: No raids start at all, neither on their own nor by chat command.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_EMPTY_HINT: Islands with nobody on them still get a turn in the island camera.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_EVENT: Time after a sub or a cheer
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_EVENT_HINT: The camera turns to whoever subscribed or cheered.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_HINT: How long the camera stays on a player before it moves on.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_ISLAND_HINT: How long the island camera shows each island before moving to the next.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_MOD_HINT: When the camera picks a moderator, it stays on them at least this long.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_SUB_HINT: When the camera picks a subscriber, it stays on them at least this long.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_OBSERVE_VIP_HINT: When the camera picks a VIP, it stays on them at least this long.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_PATHFINDING_HINT: How much time players get to find their way each frame. Higher is smoother with many players, and costs more CPU.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_PHYSICS_HINT: Simulated physics in the world. Off saves CPU with many players. Shortcut: {0}.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_PLAYER_DETAILS_HINT: The panel for the player the camera is watching. Shortcut: {0}.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_PLAYER_LIST_HINT: The list of everyone playing. {0} also hides it, with the rest of the interface.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_POST_HINT: Colour grading and a soft vignette.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_GRASS_HINT: Dense grass and flowers on the islands. Turn it off on slower computers; potato mode turns it off as well.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_GRASS_DISTANCE_HINT: How far from the camera grass grows. Lower is faster.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_GRASS_DENSITY_HINT: How thick the grass is. Lower is faster.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_TILT_SHIFT_HINT: Blurs the top and bottom of the picture, so the islands look like a miniature world.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_TILT_SHIFT_STRENGTH_HINT: How blurred the picture gets toward the top and bottom of the screen.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_TILT_SHIFT_BAND_HINT: How tall the band kept in focus is.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_TILT_SHIFT_SOFTNESS_HINT: How gently the focus fades into the blur; higher is a longer, softer fade.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_CLOUD_SHADOWS_HINT: Shadows of clouds drift slowly over the islands.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_DETAILED_WATER_HINT: Refraction, caustics, whitecaps and sunlight through the waves. Off draws a simpler sea.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_VOLUMETRIC_CLOUDS_HINT: Soft, sunlit clouds with real depth. Off shows simple low-poly clouds.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_AMBIENT_OCCLUSION_HINT: Soft shading where things meet the ground and in corners, for more depth.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_AO_STRENGTH_HINT: How dark the shading in corners and under things is.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_AMBIENT_EFFECTS_HINT: Snow on Iceheim, cherry petals over Kyojin, butterflies and gulls by day, fireflies at night, smoke from the chimneys, burning braziers and turning windmills.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_TREE_WIND_HINT: Trees, bushes and plants sway gently in the wind.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_DUNGEON_LIGHTING_HINT: Dungeons go dark and are lit by flickering torches.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_HAZE_HINT: Far islands fade softly into the air, for a sense of distance.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_WEATHER_HINT: The sky clears and clouds over as the days go by: clear spells, fair weather, cloudy and overcast skies, rain, heavy rain and thunderstorms. With the volumetric clouds.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_LIGHTNING_HINT: The lightning of a thunderstorm: flashes in the clouds and bolts that light up the land. Turn it off if flashing light bothers you or your viewers.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_WEATHER_SOUNDS_HINT: The rain, and the thunder rolling in as a storm comes.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_SOUND_EFFECTS_HINT: Axes, picks and splashes near the camera, birds, crickets, waves, wind, fires and animals.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_POTATO_HINT: The lowest graphics there are, for computers that are struggling.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_QUALITY_HINT: Lower levels draw fewer shadows and effects, for slower computers.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_QUERY_ADDRESS_HINT: Where the API listens, as host:port/path.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_QUERY_HINT: A local web API with the game's data, for overlays and tools.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_REALTIME_HINT: Day and night follow the time on this computer.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_RESET_PAGE_HINT: Puts every setting on this page back to its default
strings.UI_SETTINGS_RESET_WINDOWS_HINT: Puts every window back where it started.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_RESOLUTION_HINT: Draws the world at a lower resolution to save GPU time.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_SCREEN_SIZE_HINT: The size the game draws at.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_SHORTCUTS_HINT: The row of keyboard shortcuts along the bottom.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_TIME_HINT: Used while the day and night cycle is off.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_NIGHT_BRIGHTNESS_HINT: How much moonlight the nights have, from pitch dark to a full moon.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_VIEW_DISTANCE_HINT: How far away the world is still drawn. Lower is faster.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_VSYNC_HINT: Matches the monitor's refresh rate and stops tearing. The frame rate limit is not used while it is on.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_WINDOW_MODE_HINT: Borderless fills the screen and is the quickest to switch away from while streaming.
strings.UI_SETTINGS_ZOOM_HINT: How far one turn of the wheel zooms the player and island cameras.
strings.UI_STREAMRAID_WAR_DECLARED: {0} has declared war with an army of {1}!
strings.UI_TIP_ARMOR_NOTE: Reduces damage taken from every attack style.
strings.UI_TIP_PET: Aww! What a cute little pet!
